move.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Dear Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH team,

You have highlighted both your available capacity and Hollerau’s importance as a reference; it sounds like dependable new business would be particularly valuable. We recognise the strain caused by our late payments and will ensure reliable payment for the new series. How could an earlier payment commitment, alongside the verified reductions in material and energy costs, translate into a more competitive price?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,200 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 31.50 per unit (offer:70240-0). Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -8.5% from 2024-11 to 2025-10 (idx:AS-14404@2024-11, idx:AS-14404@2025-10). We have also put our invoice processing in order and will pay reliably on the agreed day.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 27.44 per unit, 14 days payment, 28 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Dear Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH team,

It sounds like straightforward new business matters to you: you emphasise simplicity, and you have told us you can take on additional work at short notice. We value your hands-on approach for our new series and recognise that our late payments need to give way to dependable payment. If we shorten the payment cycle and pay reliably, how can you reflect that cash-flow benefit in a sharper price?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,200 units per year for 24 months. That is a contract worth about EUR 152,838 a year. We have an offer at EUR 31.50 per unit (offer:70240-0). We have also put our invoice processing in order and will pay reliably on the agreed day. Straight talk: over the last 12 months we paid 93% of your invoices late, on average 11 days after the due date. That is on us, and it ends with this contract: every invoice paid on the due date, which brings your cash in about 11 days earlier than you are used to.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 27.23 per unit, 14 days payment, 28 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
